summary: Gyomu-docstring is a core package responsible for automating the generation, updating, merging, and validation of docstrings in source files. It provides robust mechanisms for building code contexts, planning symbol updates with retry support, rendering structured docstring components, and validating the resulting code using external formatters and linters.
responsibilities: Manage and execute docstring updates and merges for Python files.
Build structured contexts and plans for declarations requiring documentation.
Render and format docstring sections, lines, and tags.
Validate updated code sources and handle update-specific errors.

capabilities.name: Docstring Context Analysis
capabilities.description: Constructs file and declaration contexts to identify documentable code targets and dependencies.

capabilities.name: Update and Merge Planning
capabilities.description: Plans, builds, and retries docstring updates and conflict resolution merges.

capabilities.name: Docstring Rendering Engine
capabilities.description: Formats and renders docstring lines, tags, and strings according to specification.

capabilities.name: Execution and Validation
capabilities.description: Executes file updates and validates resulting code using formatting and linting tools.

capabilities.name: Error Management
capabilities.description: Defines specialized error types and handling for docstring update failures.

design_decisions: Encapsulates update planning, merging, and rendering within structured internal modules.
Separates raw docstring representation from execution and validation logic.
Leverages external linting and formatting tools to ensure validity of modified source files.
usage_guidance: Use the update processing pipeline to execute automated docstring modifications on target source files.
Rely on built-in validation and linting integrations to ensure modified files adhere to style and correctness standards.
